label: 4MP WizMind eyeball IP camera
description: 4 MP starlight eyeball camera with WDR and AI perimeter protection, RJ45 10/100Base-T. PoE 802.3af, roughly 7 W maximum; 12 VDC also supported.
notes: PoE class 802.3af, 12.95 W. Wired only. 10/100 port - no gigabit even on the 4 MP stream, so bitrate planning matters more than cabling category.
